title: Ashvamedha, as preamble to the putrakameshti
introduction: The Horse Ritual of Emperor Dasharatha is started on the banks of Sarayu River. The details of the arrangements for the participants, and visitors along with some aspects of the Vedic Ritual are narrated.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुर्दशः सर्गः ||
Thus, this is the 14th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे तस्मिन् प्राप्ते तुरंगमे |
सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे राज्ञो यज्ञोऽभ्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe tasmin prāpte turaṅgame |
sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre rājño yajño abhyavartata
verses.translation: Then after completion of one year and on regaining the ritual horse, the Emperor Dasharatha commenced his Vedic Ritual on the northern banks of River Sarayu.
notes: Comment: In asvametha yaga, a well-decorated horse will be let out with an insignia on its forehead challenging any king to capture it and face the wrath of releasing king. If any one captures the horse, he shall be strong enough to incite a war. Otherwise, the valour and invincibility of releasing king are well established and he may proceed with the ritual proper. Now that the ritual horse released during last year by King Dasharatha has come back without being captured by anyone, thus establishing the invincibility of King Dasharatha, as such he can commence the ritual proper.

verses.devanagari:
ऋष्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य कर्म चक्रुर्द्विजर्षभाः |
अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मनः
verses.iast:
ṛṣyaśṛṅgam puraskṛtya karma cakruḥ dvijarṣabhāḥ |
aśvamedhe mahāyajñe rājño'sya sumahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Keeping Rishyasringa at the helm of affairs those eminent Brahmans commenced,ashva medha , the Horse-ritual of that noble-souled Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: in Horse ritual, great ritual, of king
Rishyasringa, keeping at helm of affairs

verses.devanagari:
कर्म कुर्वन्ति विधिवद्याजका वेदपारगाः |
यथाविधि यथान्यायं परिक्रामन्ति शास्त्रतः
verses.iast:
karma kurvanti vidhivat yājakā vedapāragāḥ |
yathā vidhi yathā nyāyaṃ parikrāmanti śāstrataḥ
verses.translation: Those well-versed conductors of Vedic rituals called ritviks, have started to perform works relating to ritual as per canon and rules, and conducted them scripturally and customarily.

glosses.meaning: ritual conductors, in Vedas, well versed ones
as per canon, as per rules

verses.devanagari:
प्रवर्ग्यं शास्त्रतः कृत्वा तथैवोपसदं द्विजाः |
चक्रुश्च विधिवत्सर्वमधिकं कर्म शास्त्रतः
verses.iast:
pravargyam śāstrataḥ kṛtvā tathā eva upasadam dvijāḥ |
cakruḥ ca vidhivat sarvam adhikam karma śāstrataḥ
verses.translation: On performing pravargya ritual as per scriptures, like that upasada ritual too, those Brahmans have customarily performed all of those other rituals incidental to the main one scripturally.

glosses.meaning: pravargya ritual, as per scriptures, on performing
many more, all, rituals too, as per scriptures

verses.devanagari:
अभिपूज्य तदा हृष्टाः सर्वे चक्रुर्यथाविधि |
प्रातःसवनपूर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.iast:
abhipūjya tadā hṛṣṭāḥ sarve cakruḥ yathā vidhi |
prātaḥ savana pūrvāṇi karmāṇi munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Then all of those distinguished sages are contended with what they have performed by worshipping gods already summoned, they also conducted early morning savana ritual and its ancillaries as enjoined.

glosses.meaning: all of them, are contented with
early morning, savana rituals and its ancillary

verses.devanagari:
ऐन्द्रश्च विधिवद्दत्तो राजा चाभिषुतोऽनघः |
माध्यंदिनं च सवनं प्रावर्तत यथाक्रमम्
verses.iast:
aindraśca vidhivat datto rājā ca abhiṣuto'naghaḥ |
madhyandinam ca savanam prāvartata yathā kramam
verses.translation: The oblations addressed to Indra are well given as ordained, and the flawless king Dasharatha also crushed the Soma creeper to squeeze Soma juice, and thus the mid-day savana ritual has come to pass according to sequence.
notes: Soma creeper is from Sacrostemma Brevistigma of Asclepiadacea family and some other scholars hold the view that it is from Sarcostema Viminalis family.

glosses.meaning: [oblations addressed to] Indra, as ordained, having given
soma raja creeper, well squeezed for the juice

verses.devanagari:
तृतीयसवनं चैव राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मनः |
चक्रुस्ते शास्त्रतो दृष्ट्वा तथा ब्राह्मणपुंगवाः
verses.iast:
tṛtīya savanam caiva rājño'sya sumahātmanaḥ |
cakruḥ te śāśtrato dṛṣṭvā tathā brāhmaṇa puṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Like that those proficient Brahmans have also performed the third savana, ritual of that great-exalted soul Dasharatha according to the viewpoint of scriptures.

glosses.meaning: like that, those, Brahmans, proficient ones
from the viewpoint of scriptures, having examined
of that highly, exalted soul, of that, king
third, savana ritual, also, like that, they performed.

verses.devanagari:
आह्वयांचक्रिरे तत्र शक्रादीन् विबुधोत्तमान् |
ऋष्यशृङ्गादयो मन्त्रैः शिक्षाक्षरसमन्वितैः
verses.iast:
āhvān cakrire tatra śakrādīn vibudhottamān |
ṛṣyaśṛñgāadau mantraiḥ śikśākśara samanvitau
verses.translation: Rishyasringa and other best scholars with their well lettered and intonated Vedic hymns have invoked Indra and other gods to that place.

glosses.meaning: when trained, letters, who have them [those that still retained the pronunciation of letters though trained much earlier]

verses.devanagari:
गीतिभिर्मधुरैः स्निग्धैर्मन्त्राह्वानैर्यथार्हतः |
होतारो ददुरावाह्य हविर्भागान् दिवौकसाम्
verses.iast:
gītibhiḥ madhuraiḥ snigdhaiḥ mantra āhvānaiḥ yathārhataḥ |
hotāro dadurāvāhya havirbhāgān divaukasām
verses.translation: The hotaa-s, invocators, have welcomed the celestials for partaking oblations by singing saama Veda hymns sweetly and harmoniously, and on inviting them with Vedic hymns they have offered oblations to them.

glosses.meaning: with hymns, invited are, as befitting
to partaking celestials, oblations, they gave.

verses.devanagari:
न चाहुतमभूत्तत्र स्खलितं वा न किंचन |
दृश्यते ब्रह्मवत्सर्वं क्षेमयुक्तं हि चक्रिरे
verses.iast:
na ca ahutaṃ ābhūt tatra skhalitam vā na kiñcana |
dṛśyate brahmavat sarvam kṣemayuk{}tam hi cakrire
verses.translation: There is no unburnt oblation resulted in that fire-ritual nor even a small mishap slipped in the performance of ritual. Everything appeared canonically correct and hymn oriented. Indeed the ritual is performed in a secure way.

glosses.meaning: a little, not, slipped away, either, is there
all, appeared, to be hymn oriented
secure, enough, is performed, in deed.

verses.devanagari:
न तेष्वहःसु श्रान्तो वा क्षुधितो वापि दृश्यते |
नाविद्वान् ब्राह्मणस्तत्र नाशतानुचरस्तथा
verses.iast:
na teṣu ahassu śrānto vā kṣudhito vā na dṛśyate |
na avidvān brāhmaṇaḥ kaścin na aśata anucaraḥ tathā
verses.translation: In these days of ritual none found there to be weary or hungry, and there is no single unscholarly person, nor any Brahman without at least a hundred apprentices.

glosses.meaning: weary person, not, to be found

verses.devanagari:
ब्राह्मणा भुञ्जते नित्यं नाथवन्तश्च भुञ्जते |
तापसा भुञ्जते चापि श्रमणाश्चैव भुञ्जते
verses.iast:
brāhmaṇā bhuñjate nityam nāthavantaḥ ca bhuñjate |
tāpasā bhuñjate ca api śramaṇāḥ caiva bhuñjate
verses.translation: Given anytime the Brahmans, servants, sages, and pilgrims are fed with food for their arrival at the place of boarding is unpredictable, and that arrival is dependent on their duties for Brahmans, and by their masters for servants, and for pilgrims that do not have a particular time of arrival or departure.
notes: Some scholars tend to conclude that Ramayana might have been written in post Buddhist period by finding the words like śramaṇa etc., the famous wandering Buddhist monk sect. The word śramaṇa in Sanskrit means only a pilgrim, and pilgrimage is an ordained aspect of salvation as per Indra is the friend of traveller. Therefore wander - aitareya brahmaNa [VII.33.3] The Buddhist śramaṇa-s are the wandering monks in search of converts whereas Hindu śramana-s are pure sanyasi-s wandering for their own salvation.

glosses.meaning: masters, having [persons who have their masters i.e., servants] bhunjate = are fed
pilgrims, also, thus, are fed, like that.

verses.devanagari:
वृद्धाश्च व्याधिताश्चैव स्त्रियो बालास्तथैव च |
अनिशं भुञ्जमानानां न तृप्तिरुपलभ्यते
verses.iast:
vṛddhāḥ ca vyādhitāḥ ca eva strī bālāḥ tathā eva ca |
aniśaṃ bhuñjamānānāṃ na tṛptiḥ upalabhyate
verses.translation: Elderly people, sick ones, women and children though dining on always thus, no satisfaction to complete the meal is attained for themselves, as the food served is that pleasant.

glosses.meaning: elderly people, sick ones, also, thus
no, satisfaction to complete the meal, attained.

verses.devanagari:
दीयतां दीयतामन्नं वासांसि विविधानि च |
इति संचोदितास्तत्र तथा चक्रुरनेकशः
verses.iast:
dīyatām dīyatām annam vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca |
iti sañcoditāḥ tatra tathā cakruḥ anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Food be given abundantly, clothing be given variously" are the directives, accordingly the king's men have distributed numerously there at the ritual place.

verses.devanagari:
अन्नकूटाश्च दृश्यन्ते बहवो पर्वतोपमाः |
दिवसे दिवसे तत्र सिद्धस्य विधिवत्तदा
verses.iast:
anna kūṭāḥ ca dṛśyante bahavaḥ parvata upamāḥ |
divase divase tatra siddhasya vidhivat tadā
verses.translation: Heaps of foodstuffs are also appearing there, many of them and mountain similar, which is made available customarily, day after day.

glosses.meaning: customarily, made available, food stuff, heaps of

verses.devanagari:
नानादेशादनुप्राप्ताः पुरुषाः स्त्रीगणास्तथा |
अन्नपानैः सुविहितास्तस्मिन्यज्ञे महात्मनः
verses.iast:
nānā deśāt anuprāptāḥ puruṣāḥ strī gaṇāḥ tathā |
anna pānaiḥ suvihitāḥ tasmin yajñe mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: To that ritual of that great-souled Dasharatha masses of men and women have arrived from different countries, and they are all well-pleased with the sumptuous food and drink supplied.

glosses.meaning: men, like that, women, in masses

verses.devanagari:
अन्नं हि विधिवत्स्वादु प्रशंसन्ति द्विजर्षभाः |
अहो तृप्ताः स्म भद्रं त इति शुश्राव राघवः
verses.iast:
annam hi vidhivat svādu praśansanti dvijarṣabhāḥ |
aho tṛptāḥ sma bhadram te iti śuśrāva rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "The eminent Brahmans have appreciated the food that is prepared by perfect cooking to be relishable, and it is heard as they said,"oh, Raghava, blessed are you for we are satisfied..."

verses.devanagari:
स्वलंकृताश्च पुरुषा ब्राह्मणान्पर्यवेषयन् |
उपासते च तानन्ये सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः
verses.iast:
svalaṅkṛtāḥ ca puruṣā brāhmaṇān paryaveṣayan |
upāsante ca tān anye sumṛṣṭa maṇi kuṇḍalāḥ
verses.translation: Well-decorated men have served food to Brahmans, while others who wore gem-studded and lustrous earrings have helped them.

glosses.meaning: well decorated, gem-studded, earrings [worn by those helpers.]

verses.devanagari:
कर्मान्तरे तदा विप्रा हेतुवादान्बहूनपि |
प्राहुः स्म वाग्मिनो धीराः परस्परजिगीषया
verses.iast:
karmāntare tadā viprā hetuvādān bahūnapi |
prāhuḥ suvāgmino dhīrāḥ paraspara jigīṣayā
verses.translation: Those eminent Brahmans that are good debaters have debated many intellectual debates to defeat each other, during the gap-periods of ritual works.

glosses.meaning: many, intellectual, debates - arts of reasoning

verses.devanagari:
दिवसे दिवसे तत्र संस्तरे कुशला द्विजाः |
सर्वकर्माणि चक्रुस्ते यथाशास्त्रं प्रचोदिताः
verses.iast:
divase divase tatra saṃstare kuśalā dvijāḥ |
sarva karmāṇi cakruḥ te yathā śāstraṃ pracoditāḥ
verses.translation: Day by day those expert Brahmans have performed all ritual works as encouraged by Vashishta, and others and as contained in scriptures.

verses.devanagari:
नाषडङ्गविदत्रासीत् नाव्रतो नाबहुश्रुतः |
सदस्यास्तस्य वै राज्ञो नावादकुशला द्विजाः
verses.iast:
na aṣaḍañga vit atra āsīt na avrato na abahuśrutaḥ |
sadasyaḥ tasya vai rājño na avāda kuśalā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: There is no scholar without the knowledge of the six branches of Vedas, none who is an unavowed scholar, none who heard learnt less scriptures, and none among the members of the ritual of that king Dasharatha is an inexpert in debating, thus all are scholarly Brahmans.
notes: The six branches of Veda-s are: 1]sikṣa- phonetics, 2]vyākaraṇa- grammar, 3]candas- prosody, 4]nirukta- etymology, 5]jyotiṣ- astronomy, 6]kalapa- ritual acts.

glosses.meaning: not, in many [scriptures,] one who heard

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्ते यूपोच्छ्रये तस्मिन् षड्बैल्वाः खादिरास्तथा |
तावन्तो बिल्वसहिताः पर्णिनश्च तथापरे
श्लेष्मातकमयो दिष्टो देवदारुमयस्तथा |
द्वावेव तत्र विहितौ बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहौ
verses.iast:
prāpte yūpaḥ ucchraye tasmin ṣaḍ bailvāḥ khādirāḥ tathā |
tāvanto bilva sahitāḥ parṇinaḥ ca tathā apare
śleṣmātakamayaḥ diṣṭo devadārumayaḥ tathā |
dvāveva tatra vihitau bāhu vyasta parigrahau
verses.translation: When the time came to stake wooden ritual posts, six posts of bilwa wood, six posts of khadira wood, and further the same number of posts of parnina wood are staked. One post of sleshmaataka wood and two of devadaaru wood as stipulated are staked. Then the distance between each post is maintained at the length of extended arms.

glosses.meaning: wooden ritual posts, staking time, when neared
posts of Parnina wood [Butea frondosa,] also, further
posts of Devadaaru wood [Uvaria longifolia,][two posts, generally these posts are staked]
two, thus, arms, extended, touching [at the length of extended arms]

verses.devanagari:
कारिताः सर्व एवैते शास्त्रज्ञैर्यज्ञकोविदैः |
शोभार्थं तस्य यज्ञस्य कांचनालंकृताभवन्
verses.iast:
kāritāḥ sarva evaite śāstrajñaiḥ yajñakovidaiḥ |
śobhāartham tasya yajñasya kāñcana alaṅkṛta abhavan
verses.translation: All of those the posts are made by the authorities on scriptures and ritual scholars, and they are gold-pleated and decorated for the purpose of elegance to that ritual.

glosses.meaning: authorities on scriptures, by ritual, scholars, they are made

verses.devanagari:
एकविंशतियूपास्ते एकविंशत्यरत्नयः |
वासोभिरेकविंशद्भिरेकैकं समलंकृताः
verses.iast:
eka viṃśati yūpāḥ te eka viṃśat aratnayaḥ |
vāsobhiḥ eka viṃśadbhiḥ ekaikam samalaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They are altogether twenty-one posts, each post is twenty-one cubits in height, and each is decoratively clothed with each cloth.

glosses.meaning: having one and twenty, cubits - elbow to fingertip measure in height
one and twenty [twenty-one,] posts, they are
one to each post, decorated, they are.

verses.devanagari:
विन्यस्ता विधिवत्सर्वे शिल्पिभिः सुकृता दृढाः |
अष्टाश्रयः सर्व एव श्लक्ष्णरूपसमन्विताः
verses.iast:
vinyastā vidhivat sarve śilpibhiḥ sukṛtā dṛḍhāḥ |
aṣṭa āsrayaḥ sarva eva ślakṣṇa rūpa samanvitāḥ
verses.translation: Carpenters have carved all the posts well, and built them strongly with octahedral surfaces that are smoothened, and thereby they are implanted procedurally.

verses.devanagari:
आच्छादितास्ते वासोभिः पुष्पैर्गन्धैश्च पूजिताः |
सप्तर्षयो दीप्तिमन्तो विराजन्ते यथा दिवि
verses.iast:
ācchāditāḥ te vāsobhiḥ puṣpaiḥ gandhaiḥ ca pūjitāḥ |
sapta ṛṣayo dīptimanto virājante yathā divi
verses.translation: Those posts draped in cloths and worshipped with flowers and perfumery are irradiant, and they shone forth like the constellation of Seven Sages in the sky.
notes: The Seven Sages is the constellation of stars in the Ursa Major - The Great Bear, and is called sapta ṛśi maṇḍala. The Indian names of the Seven Sages are 1]atri, 2]angīrasa, 3]pulastya, 4]pulaha, 5]kratu, 6] marīci, 7]vaśiṣṭha.

glosses.meaning: in sky, Seven Sages, as with

verses.devanagari:
इष्टकाश्च यथान्यायं कारिताश्च प्रमाणतः |
चितोऽग्निर्ब्राह्मणैस्तत्र कुशलैः शिल्पकर्मणि
verses.iast:
iṣṭakāḥ ca yathā nyāyam kāritāḥ ca pramāṇataḥ |
cito'gniḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ tatra kuśalaiḥ śiplakarmaṇi
verses.translation: The bricks for Altar of Fire are well designed and made according to rules and standard measurements. The Brahmans who are experts in the architecture of laying Fire Altar, by calculating the ritual field with a one-ply rope and decide where and how the that shall be, the Altar of Fire is layered well with bricks in that ritual.
notes: The construction of Fire Altar itself is a ritual, called iṣṭikā cayana, where each brick is to be consecrated with hymns. On completion of the layering of bricks to the required shape, i.e., that of an eagle-like platform for a garuḍa yajña vedi etc., then Holy head bath abhiṣeka is performed to the brick-work of the Altar by pouring milk and other sacred liquids to the chanting of Vedic hymns.

glosses.meaning: according to, rules, according to standard measurements, also
by architects [particular priest-architects of Vedic rituals
by those that calculate the area of altar with a single-stranded thread called shulba ]
by expert, Brahmans, Altar of Fire, layered.

verses.devanagari:
स चित्यो राजसिंहस्य संचितः कुशलैर्द्विजैः |
गरुडो रुक्मपक्षो वै त्रिगुणोऽष्टादशात्मकः
verses.iast:
sacityo rāja siṃhasya sañcitaḥ kuśalaiḥ dvijaiḥ |
garuḍo rukmapakṣo vai triguṇo aṣṭā daśātmakaḥ
verses.translation: That Altar of Fire of that King, the Lion, is layered by expert Brahmans in the shape of an eagle with golden wings, with its size being three folds bigger than the altars of other rituals, thus it has eighteen separators, and fire is laid on it.
notes: The garuḍa, the Divine Eagle is the vehicle of Vishnu with an all-pervading vision and fastest wings. He is the only one who once brought amrita, the Divine Elixir, for the release of his mother from slavery. Hence, the Altar of Fire is given the shape of this Divine Eagle, with its wings and tail outstretched, head turned downward, and the eyes looking eastward. yajña is also termed as suparṇa i.e.,su good,parṇa winged; carrier of the oblations with his golden wings to heavens. Or its wings are glittering with gold sahasram hiraNya shakalaiH prati dinam agnim prokShati - shruti meaning every day with thousands of gold chips oblate the fire... scriptures say so. So the Altar of fire is glittering with thousands of gold chips sprinkled every day. This altar is laid threefold bigger than the usual one.

glosses.meaning: three times more [ than usual] triple sized
, eighteen in number - having eighteen separators
the fire laid on such an altar of fire layered as above.

verses.devanagari:
नियुक्तास्तत्र पशवस्तत्तदुद्दिश्य दैवतम् |
उरगाः पक्षिणश्चैव यथाशास्त्रं प्रचोदिताः
verses.iast:
niyuktāḥ tatra paśavaḥ tat tat uddiśya daivatam |
uragāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ ca eva yathā śāstram pracoditāḥ
verses.translation: In that ritual animals, serpents and birds designated to such and such deities are readied according to the scriptural directives.

glosses.meaning: that and that, deity, designated to

verses.devanagari:
शामित्रे तु हयस्तत्र तथा जलचराश्च ये |
ऋषिभिः सर्वमेवैतन्नियुक्तं शास्त्रतस्तदा
verses.iast:
śāmitre tu hayaḥ tatra tathā jalacarāḥ ca ye |
ṛṣibhiḥ sarvam evai tan niyuktam śāstrataḥ tadā
verses.translation: The sages have arranged those animals that are to be there in animal sacrifices, like horse and other aquatic animals, in that ritual according to scriptures.
notes: Many animals are sacrificed in Horse ritual. But they will be segregated as forest animals and village animals. In them many of the forest animals will be let off by taking them round the fire on to their right in salutation to fire,agni paradakśiṇa namaskara. The animals pertaining to village will be sacrificed in ritual. Hence it is up to the priests to decide which is to be retained or let off.

glosses.meaning: horse, like that, those, water, animals [are to be there, them]
by sages, arranged,. as per scriptures.

verses.devanagari:
पशूनां त्रिशतं तत्र यूपेषु नियतं तदा |
अश्वरत्नोत्तमं तस्य राज्ञो दशरथस्य च
verses.iast:
paśūnām triśatam tatra yūpeṣu niyatam tadā |
aśva ratnaḥ uttamam tasya rājño daśarathasya ha
verses.translation: Three hundred animals are tied to the ritual posts, along with the gemlike best ritual horse of that King Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: that, king Dasharatha's, horse, gemlike, best one

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्या तं हयं तत्र परिचर्य समंततः |
कृपाणैर्विशशासैनं त्रिभिः परमया मुदा
verses.iast:
kausalyā tam hayam tatra paricarya samantataḥ |
kṛpāṇaiḥ viśaśāsaḥ enam tribhiḥ paramayā mudā
verses.translation: With great delight coming on her Queen Kausalya reverently made circumambulations to the horse, and symbolically killed the horse with three knives.
notes: Here Kausalya did not butcher the horse as queens do not butcher animals in rituals, but the horse is already sacrificed. It is a symbolical act of queens to pierce with three golden knives like needles. The scripture says that all the eligible wives of the performer of ritual have to pierce that way.sauvarNiibhi suuciibhiH patnayoH ashvasya asipathaan kalayanti - shruti/ scripture. So, all the three queens have performed that symbolic act by piercing that horse, which is already dead, with golden needle-like knives. Govindaraja.

verses.devanagari:
पतत्रिणा तदा सार्धं सुस्थितेन च चेतसा |
अवसद्रजनीमेकां कौसल्या धर्मकाम्यया
verses.iast:
patatriṇā tadā sārdham susthitena ca cetasā |
avasat rajanīm ekām kausalyā dharma kāṃyayā
verses.translation: Queen Kausalya desiring the results of ritual disconcertedly resided one night with that horse that flew away like a bird.

glosses.meaning: also means a bird, one that swiftly flew away like a bird
one, night, she resided with that horse that flew away.

verses.devanagari:
होताध्वर्युस्तथोद्गाता हस्तेन समयोजयन् |
महिष्या परिवृत्त्या च वावातामपरां तथा
verses.iast:
hotā adhvaryuḥ tatha udgātā hastena samayojayan |
mahiṣyā parivṛttyā atha vāvātām aparām tathā
verses.translation: Thus, the officiating priests of the ritual, namely hota, adhwaryu and udgaata have received in their hand the Crowned Queen, the neglected wife, and a concubine of the king, next as a symbolic donation in the ritual by the performer, the king.
notes: There will be four officiating priests for these Vedic rituals. 1.brahma, 2. hota, 3.adhvaryu, 4.udgāta, to whom the king has to donate his inner core properties like wives, lands etc. By practice a king has to marry four wives. The four women of the king are 1.mahiṣi= Queen, 2.parivṛtti= neglected women, 3.vāvāta= concubine, 4.pālākali= goblet-maid. The order of donation is that the Queen to brahma, concubine to hota, neglected woman to udgāta, and the goblet-maid to the adhvaryu. Here, though the brahma ritvik is not cited along with pālākali, goblet-maid, they are implied. The donation is symbolic and later bartering with some valuable items that is redeemed. Govindaraja. There is another way of translating this. For the wording,hastena samayojayan the priests took these wives by hand to bring them in contact with the dead horse.

glosses.meaning: hotaa, adhwaryu, thus, udgaataa,[the three officiating priests of the ritual]
crowned queen, neglected wife of king

verses.devanagari:
पतत्रिणस्तस्य वपामुद्धृत्य नियतेन्द्रियः |
ऋत्विक् परमसंपन्नः श्रपयामास शास्त्रतः
verses.iast:
patatriṇaḥ tasya vapām uddhṛtya niyateindriyaḥ |
ṛtvik parama sampannaḥ śrapayāmāsa śāstrataḥ
verses.translation: Then the priest, one with controlled senses and rich in scriptural wealth, took up the omentum [fat] of the horse and cooked it as per scriptures while dropping into the altar of fire to bake as a food to the celestials.
notes: Some more scholars give a non-violent touch to this act and they say that a medicinal plant ,is offered in altar and its smell is smelt. That plant is substituted for omentum of the horse, and the wording is read differently. When the sequence is running on horse and horse's body parts how a medical plant is brought in, is unclear. And some say that a horse will not have omentum according to Vedic texts.

glosses.meaning: took up, one with controlled senses
ritwik, priest, very, wealthy in knowledge

verses.devanagari:
धूमगन्धं वपायास्तु जिघ्रति स्म नराधिपः |
यथाकालं यथान्यायं निर्णुदन् पापमात्मनः
verses.iast:
dhūma gandham vapāyāḥ tu jighrati sma narādhipaḥ |
yathā kālam yathā nyāyam nirṇudan pāpam ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The king Dasharatha smelt the smell of smoke as per time and procedure to cleanse his own sin.

glosses.meaning: as per time, as per procedure
smoke's, smell, of fat [omentum being cooked]

verses.devanagari:
हयस्य यानि चांगानि तानि सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणाः |
अग्नौ प्रास्यन्ति विधिवत् समस्ताः षोडशर्त्विजः
verses.iast:
hayasya yāni ca aṅgāni tāni sarvāṇi brāhmaṇāḥ |
agnau prāsyanti vidhivat samastāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṛtvijaḥ
verses.translation: Those remaining body parts that horse are there, the sixteen officiating priests have procedurally oblated all of them into fire.

glosses.meaning: of horse, which, body-parts are there

verses.devanagari:
प्लक्षशाखासु यज्ञानामन्येषां क्रियते हविः |
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य वैतसो भाग इष्यते
verses.iast:
plakṣa śākhāsu yajñānām anyeṣām kriyate haviḥ |
aśva medhasya yajñasya vaitaso bhāgaḥ iṣyate
verses.translation: In other rituals the oblations will be offered into sacrificial fire with spoon-like sticks of plaksha tree, but in Horse-sacrifice ritual they are offered through the vetasa creeper, a rattan plant, cane.

glosses.meaning: in other, rituals, haviH plakSa shaakhaasu kriyate = oblation, with plaksha [Ficus Venosa,] tree, on its branches, will be done
Vaitasa creepe, is to be done.

verses.devanagari:
त्र्यहोऽश्वमेधः संख्यातः कल्पसूत्रेण ब्राह्मणैः |
चतुष्टोममहस्तस्य प्रथमं परिकल्पितम्
verses.iast:
tryaho'śva medhaḥ saṅkhyātaḥ kalpa sūtreṇa brāhmaṇaiḥ |
catuṣṭomam ahaḥ tasya prathamam parikalpitam
verses.translation: The Horse Ritual is to be performed for three days as laid down in kalpa sutra-s, the rules governing such rituals, and by brahmaNa-s, the penultimate parts of Veda-s, and the one performed on the first day is called chatuhSToma ritual.

glosses.meaning: Horse ritual, is said [ to be performed]
its, first one, is said to be, chatuhSToma, is arranged.

verses.devanagari:
उक्थ्यं द्वितीयं संख्यातमतिरात्रं तथोत्तरम् |
कारितास्तत्र बहवो विहिताः शास्त्रदर्शनात्
verses.iast:
ukthyam dvitīyam saṅkhyātam atirātram tathottaram |
kāritāḥ tatra bahavo vihitāḥ śāstra darśanāt
verses.translation: The ritual on the second day is called ukthyam, and the next one performed on third day is called atiraatra. These apart many of the preordained rituals are performed there in that ritual as envisaged in scriptures.
notes: The horse-ritual is conducted only for three days. But Dasharatha got it performed with more variously connected rituals, in all his eagerness to appease gods for progeny.

glosses.meaning: likewise, later one, is atiraatra, said to be as
as ordained, many, have been performed.

verses.devanagari:
ज्योतिष्टोमायुषी चैवमतिरात्रौ विनिर्मितौ |
अभिजिद्विश्वजिच्चैवमप्तोर्यामो महाक्रतुः
verses.iast:
jyotiṣṭoma āyuṣī ca evam atirātrau vinirmitau |
abhijit viśvajit ca evam aptoryāmo mahākratuḥ
verses.translation: The rituals called jyothiSToma, aayuSi, and atiraatra rituals are performed. And also rituals of great kind like abhijit, vishwajit, aptoryaama are performed.

glosses.meaning: jyothiSToma, fire ritual, aayu yaaga, Longevity rituals

verses.devanagari:
प्राचीं होत्रे ददौ राजा दिशं स्वकुलवर्धनः
अध्वर्यवे प्रतीचीं तु ब्रह्मणे दक्षिणां दिशम्
उद्गात्रे च ततोदीचीं दक्षिणैषा विनिर्मिता |
अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे स्वयंभुविहिते पुरा
verses.iast:
prācīm hotre dadau rājā diśam svakula vardhanaḥ
adhvaryave pratīcīm tu brahmaṇe dakṣiṇām diśam
udgātre ca tathā udīcīm dakṣiṇaieṣā vinirmitā |
aśvamedhe mahāyajñe svayambhu vihite purā
verses.translation: As the promoter of his own dynasty that king Dasharatha donated eastern side to hota, western to adhvaryu, and southern to brahma. And to udgaata northern side is given in donation. These were the donations stipulated in that great ritual,ashwamedha, by the Self-Created Brahma from earlier times.

glosses.meaning: self, dynasty, developer [to promote his own dynasty]
to udgaataa, northern side gave away
earlier, by the Self-Created Brahma, as ordained

verses.devanagari:
क्रतुं समाप्य तु तदा न्यायतः पुरुषर्षभः |
ऋत्विग्भ्यो हि ददौ राजा धरां तां कुलवर्धनः
verses.iast:
kratuṃ samāpya tu tadā nyāyataḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ |
ṛtvigbhyo hi dadau rājā dharām tām kulavardhanaḥ
verses.translation: On completing the ritual thus that best man Dasharatha justifiably donated those lands to the officiating priests, called ritwiks, to promote of his dynasty.

verses.devanagari:
एवं दत्त्वा प्रहृष्टोऽभूत् श्रीमानिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः |
ऋत्विजस्त्वब्रुवन् सर्वे राजानं गतकिल्बिषम्
verses.iast:
evam dattvā prahṛṣṭo abhūt śrīmān ikśvāku nandana |
ṛtvijaḥ tu abruvan sarve rājānam gata kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Thus on giving away the vast expanses of his kingdom he that glorious one born in Ikshvaku dynasty is gladdened, but all the officiating priests said to the king who by now is rid of his sins.

glosses.meaning: that glorious one, in Ikshvaku dynasty, on born in
to king, who by now is rid of, sin

verses.devanagari:
भवानेव महीं कृत्स्नामेको रक्षितुमर्हति |
न भूम्या कार्यमस्माकं न हि शक्ताः स्म पालने
verses.iast:
bhavān eva mahīm kṛtsnām eko rakṣitum arhati |
na bhūṃyā kāryam asmākam na hi śaktāḥ sma pālane
verses.translation: "You alone are capable to protect the earth in its entirety, and there is no use for us with these lands, and we are not capable to rule it, either." Thus the priests are addressing the king.

glosses.meaning: in its entirety, earth, to protect, are capable
for us, with lands, no, work
not, in ruling, capable, we are.

verses.devanagari:
रताः स्वाध्यायकरणे वयं नित्यं हि भूमिप |
निष्क्रयं किंचिदेवेह प्रयच्छतु भवानिति
verses.iast:
ratāḥ svādhyāya karaṇe vayam nityam hi bhūmipa |
niṣ.hkrayam kiñcit eva iha prayacchatu bhavān iti
verses.translation: "We are always preoccupied with self-study and teaching of scriptures, oh, king, thus you may give us something else in barter, any modest thing."

verses.devanagari:
मणिरत्नं सुवर्णं वा गावो यद्वा समुद्यतम् |
तत्प्रयच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ धरण्या न प्रयोजनम्
verses.iast:
maṇi ratnam suvarṇam vā gāvo yad vā samudyatam |
tat prayaccha naraśreṣṭa dharaṇyā na prayojanam
verses.translation: "Let best gems, gold, or cows or anything else that is available you may give us, what is the use of these vast expanses to us." So said the scholars.

glosses.meaning: cows, whatever, else,[whatever that is,] available
with vast expanses, what is the use, none.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तो नरपतिर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः |
गवां शतसहस्राणि दश तेभ्यो ददौ नृपः
दशकोटीः सुवर्णस्य रजतस्य चतुर्गुणम् |
verses.iast:
evam ukto narapatiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ veda pāragaiḥ |
gavām śata sahasrāṇi daśa tebhyo dadau nṛpaḥ
daśa koṭi suvarṇasya rajatasya catur guṇam |
verses.translation: The king Dasharatha, the lord of people, thus requested by the scholarly Vedic Brahmans gave them millions of cows, ten of ten million gold coins, and the silver four times thereof.
notes: Silver is prohibited for donation in such rituals, but here it is being given as barter for the lands earlier donated, hence it is an acceptable item.

glosses.meaning: that king veda paaragaaH braahmaNaiH = by Vedic scholars, Brahmans
thus, one who is said so, the king
cows, hundred, thousand, ten [ten lakhs i.e., 10,00,000, a million]

verses.devanagari:
ऋत्विजश्च ततः सर्वे प्रददुः सहिता वसु
ऋष्यशृङ्गाय मुनये वसिष्ठाय च धीमते |
verses.iast:
ṛtvijaḥ ca tataḥ sarve pradaduḥ sahitā vasu
ṛṣyaśṛngāya munaye vasiṣṭhāya ca dhīmate |
verses.translation: Then all those officiating priests collectively gave that wealth to sage Rishyasringa and to the enlightened sage Vashishta.

glosses.meaning: to Rishyasringa, to Sage Vashishta, also, enlightened

verses.devanagari:
ततस्ते न्यायतः कृत्वा प्रविभागं द्विजोत्तमाः
सुप्रीतमनसः सर्वे प्रत्यूचुर्मुदिता भृशम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ te nyāyataḥ kṛtvā pravibhāgam dvijottamāḥ
suprīta manasaḥ sarve pratyūcuḥ muditā bhṛśam |
verses.translation: Then all of those Brahmans are well satisfied at heart and distributed among themselves the wealth passed on by Rishyasringa and Vashishta, and then they said,"We are highly gladdened."

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रसर्पकेभ्यस्तु हिरण्यं सुसमाहितः
जांबूनदं कोटिसंंख्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ तदा |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prasarpakebhyastu hiraṇyam susamāhitaḥ
jāmbūnadam kooṭi saṅkhyam brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tadā |
verses.translation: Then to the other Brahmans who arrived there to see the ritual, King Dasharatha sincerly donated ten million gold coins.

glosses.meaning: to those who have come to see the ritual, to Brahmans
[the gold that has come out] of Jambu river

verses.devanagari:
दरिद्राय द्विजायाथ हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम्
कस्मैचिद्याचमानाय ददौ राघवनंदनः |
verses.iast:
daridrāya dvijāya atha hasta ābharaṇam uttamam
kasmai cit yācamānāya dadau rāghava nandanaḥ |
verses.translation: That descendent of Raghava dynasty gave an excellent hand ornament to someone who is an impoverished Brahman and who is beseeching.

glosses.meaning: one who is beseeching, someone, impoverished, Brahman

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रीतेषु विधिवत् द्विजेषु द्विजवत्सलः
प्रणाममकरोत्तेषां हर्षव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prīteṣu vidhivat dvijeṣu dvija vatsalaḥ
praṇāmam akarot teṣām harṣa vyākulita indriyaḥ |
verses.translation: While those Brahmans are becoming happy then that king and the patron of Brahmans venerated them dutifully with his senses fluttering with happiness.

glosses.meaning: Brahmans, while happy, they are becoming
to them, dutifully, veneration, he made.

verses.devanagari:
तस्याशिषोऽथ विविधा ब्राह्मणैः समुदाहृताः
उदारस्य नृवीरस्य धरण्यां पतितस्य च |
verses.iast:
tasya āśiṣo'tha vividhā brāhmaṇaiḥ samudāhṛtāḥ
udārasya nṛvīrasya dharaṇyām patitasya ca |
verses.translation: Then that benevolent and valiant King Dasharatha prostrated on ground venerating the Brahmans, and the Brahmans too chanted various blessing hymns on that prostrating king.
notes: The blessings are also Vedic hymns and particular parts of Vedic hymns are chanted for particular occasion called āśīrvacana hymns. To date this practice is continued where a Brahmin priest is commissioned to perform even a domestic ritual. In effect, it shall be construed that these are not the blessings of the Brahmin priests who are chanting, but it is the blessing of Veda itself.

glosses.meaning: by Brahmans, various, blessings, are chanted.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रीतमना राजा प्राप्य यज्ञमनुत्तमम्
पापापहं स्वर्नयनं दुस्तरं पार्थिवर्षभैः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prīta manā rajāa prāpya yajñam anuttamam
pāpa apaham svar nayanam dustaram pārthivarṣabhaiḥ |
verses.translation: Then that king is gladdened at heart for the successful achievement of the completion of that excellent ritual that removes sin and that leads to heaven as well, and that which cannot be undertaken by many of the best kings.

glosses.meaning: by kings, best ones, impossible to undertake

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽब्रवीदृष्यशृंगं राजा दशरथस्तदा
कुलस्य वर्धनं त्वं तु कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत |
verses.iast:
tato'bravīt ṛśyśṛṅgam rājā daśarathaḥ tadā
kulasya vardhanam tvam tu kartum arhasi suvrata |
verses.translation: Thereafter king Dasharatha said to sage Rishyasringa thus,"oh, sage with best vows, you alone are eligible to perform the ritual for the expansion of my dynasty."

glosses.meaning: to perform, it is apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
तथेति च स राजानमुवाच द्विजसत्तमः |
भविष्यन्ति सुता राजंश्चत्वारस्ते कुलोद्वहाः
verses.iast:
tatheti ca sa rājānam uvāca dvijasattamaḥ |
bhaviṣyanti sutā rājan catvāraḥ te kulodvahāḥ
verses.translation: That best Brahman Rishyasringa saying yes to the proposal, said this to king Dasharatha,"oh, king, there will be four sons to you that ennoble your dynasty.[1-14-59b, c]

verses.devanagari:
स तस्य वाक्यं मधुरं निशम्य
प्रणम्य तस्मै प्रयतो नृपेन्द्र |
जगाम हर्षं परमं महात्मा
तं ऋष्यशृङ्गं पुनरप्युवाच
verses.iast:
sa tasya vākyam madhuram niśaṃya
praṇaṃya tasmai prayato nṛpendra |
jagāma harṣam paramam mahātmā
tam ṛṣyaśR^ñgam punarapi uvāca
verses.translation: On hearing the sweet words of Sage Rishyasringa, he that king of kings Dasharatha went into a state of ecstasy and venerating that great soul, Rishyasringa, again said this to him.

glosses.meaning: he [the king,] his [Sage's,] words, sweet ones, on hearing
went into, gladness, very much, great-souled
to him, to Rishyasringa, again said.
